findings.body: A malformed retained report with `commands: [null]` makes this loop dereference `command.exitCode` and throw instead of returning `{ ok: false, issues }`. Validate each command entry and its `stdout` before accessing or hashing it so missing or malformed data is rejected cleanly.
findings.title: Reject malformed command entries without throwing

overall_explanation: The verifier handles missing top-level data but throws on malformed entries in the commands array, so malformed retained evaluation data can terminate verification instead of producing a rejection result.
